# Limine protocol header

The vendored `limine.h` is from the official `Limine-Bootloader/limine-protocol`
repository, commit `877c2d4c50e170575f8b8e7fbf7b8fa89b1dc157`
(blob `7fc9df9f358cf98f5f5a97e7c6daa5a9054df015`).

It is distributed under the 0BSD license; the SPDX identifier and notice are
retained in the header itself.

The Limine bootloader binary/source utility used for ISO creation is pinned
separately in the root Makefile to commit
`5be26a73d7b7b4d4477d18be94e1d16e615adf56` (Limine v11.4.1 binary branch).
